title: Fictional draft evidence-complete follow-up assessment of API-100-A3 for Summit Analytics CAP-140

assessor.name: Morgan Ellis
assessor.independence_statement: This fictional assessor is presented only to illustrate a bounded follow-up record and has no operational ownership of the fictional CAP-140 gateway.

assessment_scope.subject: Fictional Summit Analytics workforce-research assistant CAP-140
assessment_scope.boundary: One later API-100-A3 emergency-restriction exercise on the fictional CAP-140 staging gateway with a complete event trail, following the inconclusive evidence recorded in ASR-ENG5-API100-A3-INCONCLUSIVE and FND-ENG5-API100-A3-INCONCLUSIVE.
exclusions: Production restriction and recovery behavior, production bypass paths, repeated operation over time, API-100-A1 and API-100-A2, and capability-wide operating effectiveness were not assessed.
assessment_scope.population: The fictional CAP-140 staging gateway emergency model-restriction path.
assessment_scope.sample: One controlled staging restriction exercise using the fictional approved test model alias; this is not a statistical sample.

methods.procedure: API-100-A3 - Test: Exercise emergency provider or model restriction.
methods.object: Fictional CAP-140 staging gateway and restriction harness, evidence EVD-ENG6-API100-RESTRICTION.
methods.expected_result: The emergency restriction blocks new requests to the selected model alias and records the action in a complete, reviewable event trail.
methods.actual_work: Executed one controlled staging exercise. The ordered event trail records the restriction command and response, and a subsequent request to the selected test alias was blocked. No production request or recovery process was exercised.

determination_rationale: The complete event trail supports that the restriction operated in this one staging exercise and resolves the scoped evidence-capture follow-up associated with FND-ENG5-API100-A3-INCONCLUSIVE. This distinct result does not revise ASR-ENG5-API100-A3-INCONCLUSIVE, ASR-ENG4-API100-A3, or ASR-ENG3-API100. Production operation, API-100-A1/A2, and sustained operating effectiveness were not assessed, so this result does not determine API-100 satisfied.

findings.statement: This distinct follow-up finding records resolution of the incomplete event-trail concern in FND-ENG5-API100-A3-INCONCLUSIVE for one later API-100-A3 staging exercise; it does not replace that historical finding or result.

disposition.action: The fictional owner retained the complete event trail for one staging restriction exercise; the assessor verified that the selected test alias was blocked.
disposition.rationale: The complete event trail supports resolution of this result's bounded evidence-capture finding and the limited staging exercise outcome. FND-ENG5-API100-A3-INCONCLUSIVE and its result remain unchanged historical records; this disposition establishes no production or sustained effectiveness.

limitations: This is a fictional follow-up result and remains Draft.
The result is limited to one API-100-A3 staging exercise and does not revise ASR-ENG5-API100-A3-INCONCLUSIVE or any earlier assessment result.

One staging exercise does not establish production behavior, recovery behavior, sustained operating effectiveness, capability-wide effectiveness, API-100-A1/A2 outcomes, certification, compliance, equivalence, endorsement, or assurance.

change_history.author: Morgan Ellis
